question: What formulation must be uttered as the heart-mantra when addressing Paramahaṃsinī?
premises: The heart-mantra is the object to be uttered
The instruction is addressed to Paramahaṃsinī
inference: One should utter the heart-mantra beginning with tārā, O Paramahaṃsinī.
plain_english: O Paramahaṃsinī, one should utter the heart-mantra beginning with tārā.
